task_name: Show formatted key on card face and list view

concerns_addressed: The CLI-authoritative fan-out includes T7, but the correction contains no client files and does not modify CardView, ListView, BoardPage, or any T7 behavior.
The server-side correction only coordinates the T4/T6 transaction lock order and adds a server integration race test; T7's formatted-key display contract remains intact.

strengths: The correction commit contains no client-side changes, so the previously approved CardView/ListView implementation and its drag-overlay behavior are unaffected.
The cross-task regression is implemented with real HTTP and PostgreSQL operations and validates committed state without sleeps, retries, or unrelated UI changes.
The composed column-remap integration entrypoint retains all existing scenarios and passed all 12 tests; root lint and typecheck also pass.
The exact correction file set is limited to server/src/routes/cards.ts and server/src/routes/columns-is-done-remap.failure.test.ts, with no log.json or T7-owned file included.

issues.description: The added integration test block has inconsistent indentation/formatting and npx biome check reports that the file would be reformatted. This does not affect T7 behavior and is non-blocking.
